question: Where can I find a fast food restaurant that are within 30 kilometers and lie northwest of Speert Green, Wayne, NJ?
sql: SELECT poi_name FROM pois WHERE amenity = 'fast_food' AND ST_DWithin( geometry :: geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Speert Green%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Wayne%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NJ%' LIMIT 1 ) :: geography, 30000 ) AND degrees( ST_Azimuth( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Speert Green%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Wayne%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NJ%' LIMIT 1 ), geometry ) ) BETWEEN 292.5 AND 337.5;
